channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: NHL Rumor Roundup: Updates On Blues' Robert Thomas And Rangers' Vincent Trocheck
item.description: It's been nearly a week since the trade deadline, but speculation persists regarding the futures of St. Louis Blues center Robert Thomas and New York Rangers center Vincent Trocheck.

item.title: Who Should The Ottawa Senators Draft With Their New First-Rounder?
item.description: Instead of forfeiting their first-round pick in the 2026 NHL draft, the Ottawa Senators will now select 32nd overall. Here are four prospects they should follow, including a long shot, a safe player and an interesting project.

item.title: The Toronto Maple Leafs Absolutely Should Not Trade Matthew Knies
item.description: The Toronto Maple Leafs are having an abysmal season, and that's leading to trade speculation. Wild rumors are swirling, but the Leafs' future hinges on keeping their young stars. Trading Matthew Knies would be a mistake.

item.title: How Will New 'Millionaires Tax' Affect The Seattle Kraken?
item.description: The Seattle Kraken may not have taken full advantage of being in a tax-free state up to this point. A new 'millionaires tax' is expected to come into effect in 2028, and it could affect their ability to attract and retain players.

item.title: The Wraparound: Will The Montreal Canadiens Run With Jacob Fowler In The Playoffs?
item.description: Emma Lingan and Michael Augello discuss Jacob Fowler's play, Nick Schmaltz's contract extension, Cutter Gauthier's next contract and more.

item.title: Cutter Gauthier's Sophomore NHL Season Is Anything But A Slump As Ducks Fly High
item.description: Good vibes surround Cutter Gauthier and the Anaheim Ducks as they lead the Pacific Division. But what's made Gauthier's season so impressive?

item.title: 'There's Nothing Fake About Him': Seth Jarvis' Winterhawks Coach Describes What Sets The Olympian Apart
item.description: Seth Jarvis was one of seven Portland Winterhawks alumni who played at the Olympics, and the Canadian came home with the silver medal. Portland GM-president Mike Johnston shares his insight on Jarvis when he played in the WHL.

item.title: Paralympics 2026: How Para Hockey Differs From Olympic Standup Hockey
item.description: There are different rules and regulations that make Para hockey stand out. Let's take a look as the 2026 Paralympic tournament reaches the playoff stages.

item.title: NHL Hot Seat Radar: Leafs' Treliving, Red Wings' Yzerman Face Pressure Again
item.description: The NHL's trade deadline has passed, but the pressure on certain NHL figures is only warming up. Which NHL figures are on the hot seat right now?

item.title: 'Of Course It's Gudas': Social Media Reacts To Ducks Captain Kneeing Maple Leafs' Auston Matthews
item.description: Anaheim Ducks captain Radko Gudas received a major penalty and game misconduct for kneeing Toronto Maple Leafs captain Auston Matthews, who left the game injured. Observers took to social media to react to the hit.
